Content: The figure above shows a thin, square, nonconducting sheet of positive charge uniformly distributed over its area. The length of `text(each side)` of the sheet is `a`. Point `C` is at the center of the sheet. Point `X` is a distance `d` above the center of the sheet, and point `Y` is a distance `2d` above the center of the sheet. Assume `a> >d`. The effect of gravity is negligible.
